Smoking Hut.description: A humble shack where food is preserved and flavored by smoke and heat.

Mushroom Log.description: A pile of logs that can be used to grow mushrooms. Can only be used once, the mushrooms will consume the logs.

Fermentation Barrel.description: A sturdy barrel used to preserve foods, enhancing flavor and longevity. Use salt, honey, vinegar or oil to preserve your goods.

Press.description: Press is a station used to transform input food items into different food items, also changing some of their diet types.

Seed Maker.description: A machine that extracts and prepares seeds from fruit.

Titanium Water Pump.description: Titanium Water Pump supplies water to the Irrigation Pipe in a 7x7 area around it.

Icebox.description: Cold storage box that prevents spoilage.
